verdict.rationale: 2FAS documents a browser extension that pairs with the phone and delivers 2FA tokens into the sign-in page without retyping, after the user confirms in the mobile app. 2FAS Pass separately documents browser-extension access and autofill. Passkey autofill is never mentioned, so only the TOTP half of the story is evidenced, and each fill needs a phone confirmation. missing for 10: passkey autofill support, independent or hands-on corroboration of TOTP autofill, fill without a per-use phone confirmation step.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a browser extension autofills my TOTP codes and passkeys during login instead of making me retype them

citations.quote: Click the browser extension icon when you need to enter a 2FA token, then confirm in the mobile app. You don't have to retype anything.
The 2FAS Auth browser extension pairs with your phone to deliver 2FA tokens where you sign in
Generate TOTP, HOTP and Steam Guard codes on iOS, Android and via browser extensions.
Access through the Browser Extension or using Autofill must be confirmed in 2FAS Pass.
